_comment: Issue #42 step (b): masked expert round on NoSidewalk labels outside Seattle (analysis/nosidewalk_round.py). phase1 = seeded random sample of each city's eligible labels to crop and score; phase2 = items the rater rates, split over the strata by shares. A label is in the pass stratum when at least pass_models of the five fold models give Agree at served accuracy >= gate. The rater's user_id is passed in the environment, never stored here.
